title: FLA import: button/symbol BG layer shape dropped — PlayButton background empty, button face missing
description: Golden field-level gap. The PlayButton symbol has two layers, 'Text' and 'BG'. After import, the 'Text' layer correctly holds a gradient shape + 'Click to Play' text, but the 'BG' layer's keyframe imports as isEmpty=true with zero displayObjects — the button BACKGROUND shape is dropped. In golden.swf the button-face DefineShape (bounds +/-1231/+/-458) carries 17 fill styles (solid + 16 linearGradient); our compiled equivalent has only the single Text-layer gradient, so the published button is missing its background. Investigate why the BG layer's CPicShape is not decoded (possible: the shape record on that layer desyncs or is read as empty during symbol-timeline parsing). ACCEPTANCE: PlayButton's BG layer imports a non-empty shape, and the compiled button-face shape matches golden's fill set (or at least is non-empty) and renders in Ruffle. Related: 1169 (button type), 1183 (scene filter desync).
